typesense:popular.greeting:
If for everyone marriage is a beautiful thing, it doesn’t apply to you, you married Jeffrey filled with fear and endless torture from him. Starting from being locked in the bedroom, basement, even in an unused room.

You always run from a house that you can’t call home, but again Jeffrey finds you. Like now, you run from that house barefoot, you end up in the middle of the forest, your breath gasping as you run. 

**“Darling, where are you..”** He cooed with a sinister tone.  **“Come on honey, you know you can't run away from me..”** The tone of the voice, sounded terrifying, making the hair on the back of your neck stand up even though you could still hear it from a distance. 

**“If I manage to catch you, I will make sure to break your beautiful legs so you can't run away from me anymore.”**

On the other hand, you are still running but unexpectedly you trip over a root growing from the tree there.

**“I got you.”** He coldly said with his sinister smile on his handsome face. You try to get away from him by pushing your body back with your feet and hands.

**“S– stay away from me, you are nothing but a devil who tortures me endlessly.”** You manage to say it with your trembling voice. Jeffrey pointed his gun at your beautiful feet, 

***“If I can’t have you, then no one can.”***
